domain_correction.interior: G_C=I+C^*C with C=partial_q^2-1/4 on the unpunctured whole-line H2 domain
domain_correction.wall: nonzero left/right endpoint values belong to the maximal broken domain H2((-infinity,0)) direct-sum H2((0,infinity)) and its boundary quotient
domain_correction.wrong: treat the wall columns w_theta,j_theta themselves as ordinary vectors in the unpunctured Dom(C)
domain_correction.reason: the wall modes exp(+/-q/2) are generalized kernel directions and are not global L2 vectors; arbitrary endpoint traces require broken-domain lifts

retained_interior_bound.scope: global interior vectors in the unpunctured C graph domain
retained_interior_bound.not_scope: boundary quotient coordinates or lifts with a derivative jump at q=0

explicit_broken_lift.lift: R(a,b)(q)=a exp(q) for q<0 and b exp(-q) for q>0
explicit_broken_lift.halfline_C: C R=(3/4)R on each open half-line

interpretation: The canonical exponential Poisson lift still has a strict derivative margin, but its constant is 4/5, not the sharper whole-line spectral constant. The discrepancy records the puncture/jump boundary rather than an analytic error.

combined_system_metric.necessary: retain interior C-graph energy, boundary endpoint metric, and the chosen Poisson lift as separate typed blocks
combined_system_metric.overlap: cross terms between the lift range and zero-trace interior domain must be handled by the overlap operator K=Gamma R0-I or an orthogonalized Poisson decomposition
combined_system_metric.conditional_bound: if the decomposition is Green-orthogonal, the derivative loading norm is at most max(4/5,sqrt((sqrt(17)-1)/8))=4/5
combined_system_metric.not_yet: orthogonality and the full prime/reciprocal/linking loading bound

next_test: Decompose the broken maximal domain as Dom(C_min) plus ran(R) using the explicit trace right inverse. Compute the C-graph cross operator between these summands. If it can be eliminated by a uniformly bounded triangular correction, use the resulting orthogonalized lift to evaluate the even wall and odd jump loading Gram.
conclusion: The source completion differential still supplies strict interior coercivity, and the explicit boundary Poisson lift separately has strict ratio 4/5. But wall coordinates cannot be inserted directly into the whole-line C graph. The correct chamber calculation is a boundary-triple decomposition with an overlap correction, exactly matching the prior joint-trace architecture.
